title: Settlement Standard for Pet-Damage Claims under Host Damage Protection (HostCover)
content:
**Host Damage Protection (HostCover) standard for settling an approved pet-damage claim** (damage by a guest's pet, a service animal included).

1. The pet-damage reimbursement starts from the loss the claims team verified on the approved pet-damage claim.
2. A pet-damage claim bears an equal share of the stay's deductible: the plan level's deductible divided by the number of approved claims filed on the same stay.
3. From the verified pet-damage loss, every guest payment recorded on the pet-damage claim, net of reversals, is subtracted together with the pet-damage claim's deductible share.
4. The result is floored at 0.00 and then cut to the lowest of the level's pet-damage sublimit, the level's per-claim limit and the plan's remaining aggregate, which is the level's annual aggregate limit less the reimbursements, net of recoveries, posted on the plan in the current plan year.
5. The pet-damage reimbursement is rounded half up to the nearest cent only at the end.

The deductible, pet-damage sublimit, per-claim limit and annual aggregate limit are those of the plan's HostCover level.

## Worked figure (hypothetical inputs, not the figures of any level)

| | |
|---|---|
| Verified pet-damage loss | 3150.00 |
| Level deductible 400.00, approved claims on the stay 2: deductible share | 200.00 |
| Guest payment recorded 600.00, reversed 250.00: net | 350.00 |
| 3150.00 less 350.00 less 200.00 | 2600.00 |
| Pet-damage sublimit 2000.00; per-claim limit 20000.00; remaining aggregate 18000.00: lowest | 2000.00 |
| Pet-damage reimbursement | 2000.00 |

Had the pet-damage sublimit been 3000.00, the lowest ceiling would be 3000.00 and the reimbursement 2600.00.
